title: Yukti AI answer contract (agent → UI), one per agent turn

spoken_summary.description: 2–4 sentences for Leda to speak; Indian number system

display_text.description: brief thread text with inline citation markers [1]

total_rows.description: Full row count when rows[] is a page/sample

contract_version.description: Absent = 1. v2 adds U2.1 fields; v3 = all SPEC-03 §5.1 ledger fields (proposed_action, job, provenance, clarify, actions, artifacts, statement, email_draft, dcf_model …). All optional.

definition_id.description: Canonical rule definition ID from app/semantic/definitions.yaml (e.g. DELHI_GT5_CONT_V1)

caveat.description: data note shown inside Sources (caveats, assumptions)

actions.description: P2F.6 (SPEC-08 §7.3): top-level mirror of visual.actions when visual.type='actions'

artifacts.description: P2H.4 / P4.6 (SPEC-10 §5): exported files attached to this turn

email_draft.description: P2H.4 (SPEC-07 §4.5): top-level mirror of visual.email_draft when visual.type='email_draft'

ui_action.description: optional screen command bundled with the answer (e.g. chart_kind, download)

summary.description: Question shown and spoken, e.g. 'Can I run the DCF valuation agent in the background? It takes about 15 seconds.'

inputs.description: Resolved inputs that will run if confirmed (validated against the agent input_schema)

voice_confirm_hint.description: e.g. 'Say yes, run it, or cancel.'

result_ref.description: turn_id of the result contract, or gs:// URI of the artifact

artifacts.description: Artifact shape owned by SPEC-10 §5 ({export_id, kind, filename, url, rows, columns, masked, created_at, expires_at, sha256}); jobs fill at least kind, export_id, filename

detail.description: e.g. 'ONGC AR FY2023-24, Standalone P&L p.245'

chart_spec.description: Small declarative spec; the UI maps it to ECharts. No code from the model.

value.description: scalar for = != > >= < <= like; array for in / not_in; [low, high] for between

query_spec.description: Frozen, versioned description of the data question (U2.1 / B2). The UI may echo it back with a spec_patch for refinements.

spec_patch.description: Partial query_spec merged onto the current one (refine in place)

compare.description: split the current answer into side-by-side entities

ref.description: row/category the insight refers to (for highlight)
